description: This file implements a client for interacting with the WhatsApp Cloud API, handling webhook events such as incoming calls and call terminations. It manages WebRTC connections for ongoing calls, processes webhook verification and signature validation, and provides methods for call control like termination and connection handling.

classes.name: WhatsAppClient
classes.description: Client class for managing WhatsApp API interactions, WebRTC connections, and webhook event processing, including call setup, termination, and verification.

methods.description: Validates the webhook request's HMAC signature to ensure authenticity.

methods.name: str _filter_sdp_for_whatsapp(self, sdp: str)
methods.description: Filters SDP to only include sha-256 fingerprints, ensuring compatibility with WhatsApp WebRTC requirements.

methods.description: Handles an incoming call connect event by establishing a WebRTC connection, pre-accepting, and accepting the call via WhatsApp API.

methods.name: bool _handle_terminate_event(self, call: WhatsAppTerminateCall)
methods.description: Handles a call termination event by disconnecting WebRTC connection and cleaning up resources.
